sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.name) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name) FROM enlist AS T1 LEFT JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.organ = 'fire_department'
SELECT COUNT(name) FROM longest_absense_from_school WHERE month = 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT name FROM enlist GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(organ) >= 2)
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM enlist AS T1 INNER JOIN enrolled AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.organ = 'peace_corps' AND T2.school = 'ucsd'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM unemployed AS T1 INNER JOIN no_payment_due AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.bool = 'neg'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM unemployed AS T1 INNER JOIN longest_absense_from_school AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.month = 0
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM unemployed AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.organ = 'army'
SELECT COUNT(name) FROM disabled WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM disabled AS T1 INNER JOIN no_payment_due AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.bool = 'pos'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN month = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(name) FROM longest_absense_from_school
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bool = 'pos' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN bool = 'neg' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM no_payment_due
SELECT name, school FROM enrolled WHERE month = 15
SELECT school, month FROM enrolled WHERE name = 'student214'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 INNER JOIN disabled AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.month = 9
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name) FROM person AS T1 LEFT JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name
SELECT COUNT(name) FROM enrolled WHERE school = 'smc' AND month = 1
SELECT name FROM enrolled WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM enlist GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(organ) = 2) GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(school) = 2
SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN month = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN month = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN month = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM longest_absense_from_school
SELECT T1.name FROM enrolled AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.school = 'occ' AND T2.organ = 'fire_department'

SELECT T1.name FROM male AS T1 INNER JOIN unemployed AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN disabled AS T3 ON T1.name = T3.name INNER JOIN longest_absense_from_school AS T4 ON T1.name = T4.name WHERE T4.month = 5
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy AS T1 LEFT JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name
